name: @gjsify/integration-tls-session
description: Integration tests: TLS session resumption + channel binding round-trip on GJS and Node. Validates @gjsify/tls-native Phase 2 SessionAccess end-to-end against a real TLS handshake — the follow-up to PR #360 that deferred the round-trip test once the C shim landed.

scripts.build:test: gjsify run setup-fixtures && gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
